name: elite-credit-ai
description: Credit-journey suite for US consumers (Latino focus). Covers the full arc: forensic repair when there are FCRA/FDCPA/Reg F anomalies, score optimization, and maintenance + financial education. Bilingual ES/EN intake, multi-select goals, deep audit of tri-bureau PDFs, prioritized dispute strategies, FCRA-grade dispute letters with personalized hardship narrative, and journey continuity across sessions via Cowork Memoria. Triple output per audit: technical forensic report (.md) + plain-language consumer summary (.md) + structured analysis delivered directly in the Cowork chat (executive summary, findings consolidated by type with friendly creditor names, prioritized action plan, dispute-letter offer). The interactive visual dashboard lives in the elitecredit.ai webapp.
